title: iREPA representation-alignment training graph
host: salt10 (2x BW DCU, DTK 26.04, system torch 2.9.0+das.opt1.dtk2604, Python 3.11.9)

A_slot08_capture.contract: capture is exactly the image span of the tapped slot_08 block output, read at an eager outer-loop point (never a hook, never inside a compiled/ckpt block); row-major raster T=H*W, no pad/resize
A_slot08_capture.key_constraint: slot 8 is a G1 growth slot, active only at depth 20/24 (not base 16)
verified_by: test_slot08_capture_dense_vs_packed_parity (full production d=2560 model, depth 20, SDPA vs FA4 varlen)

B_projector.contract: IRepaAlignment(in_channels) = locked MixedPrecisionConv2d (bf16 w / fp32 b), out=768 k=3 s=1 p=1 d=1 g=1 bias; bf16 [B,T,D]+(H,W) -> [B,T,768]; TypeError non-bf16, ValueError H*W!=T / width

C_zscore_target.contract: spatial_zscore_target(teacher_features, gamma, eps) = per-channel spatial z-score of the frozen teacher [B,T,768] bf16 features in float32

D_cosine_loss.contract: irepa_alignment_loss = fp32 F.cosine_similarity(dim=-1); per_sample=(1-cosine).mean(1); returns (per_sample, cosine_per_sample)

E_lambda_schedule.contract: IRepaLambdaSchedule + irepa_weight_for_update: stateless, deterministic function of successful-update count; ramp in/hold/ramp out

F_combined_objective.contract: per-sample combined = main + lambda*irepa (fp32); section-14 NO lambda=0 skip (full graph, exact-zero contribution + exact-zero grad)

G_telemetry_v11.contract: schema 11; 2 new timing phases (irepa_teacher, irepa_projector); 6 iREPA fields; t-bin MAIN-JLT-only; observer re-derives main+weighted==combined bit-exact fp32 + one-update lambda uniformity + finiteness; payload publishes 6 fields

H_zero_impact.contract: disabled (irepa_alignment None) = byte-identical legacy tuple; enabled lambda=0 = exact-zero contribution, legacy grads torch.equal

I_production_gate.contract: fail-closed: enabled iREPA with a missing/inconsistent prerequisite raises a blocker (no silent degrade)

J_frozen_and_parity.parity: iprea-P4 2 failed == dev 2 failed (both shared baseline); iprea-only=0, base-only=0; no skip/xfail added

test_isolation_note: the compile-stability GPU test injects torch.dynamo __compiled_fn_* namespace artifacts that test_distributed_compile asserts on; the GPU file carries an autouse fixture removing those artifacts before/after each test (no production change)
